scripts.chroma: mkdir -p data/chroma && node agent/node_modules/chromadb/dist/cli.mjs run --path data/chroma --port 8000
scripts.typecheck: bun --filter @agentic-ai/agent typecheck && bun --filter @agentic-ai/backend typecheck && bun --filter @agentic-ai/frontend typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test:unit: bun test --coverage $(find agent backend -name '*.unit.test.ts' -not -path '*/node_modules/*') && bun --filter @agentic-ai/frontend test:unit
scripts.test:integration: bun test --timeout 120000 --max-concurrency 1 $(find agent backend tests -name '*.int.test.ts' -not -path '*/node_modules/*') && bun --filter @agentic-ai/frontend test:integration
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:integration && bun run test:e2e && bun run test:security
